title: Trading Journal Mcp
author: Bonaccitrade
selftext:
I think most trading journals measure the wrong thing.

They record entries, exits, win rate, drawdown, and P&L.

Useful data—but they rarely capture the quality of the decision behind the trade.

That is the problem I wanted to solve with Aureon.

A losing trade is not always a bad decision.

A winning trade is not always a good one.

A trader can follow a strong process and still lose.

Another can break every rule and get rewarded by luck.

Most journals treat both outcomes as the full story.

So I stopped asking:

How can I build a better trading journal?

And started asking:

How can software learn how a trader makes decisions?

That question became the foundation of Aureon AI Trading Coach.

Aureon keeps broker facts and trader reasoning separate.

Broker facts include:

\\\* Entry and exit

\\\* Symbol and direction

\\\* Position size

\\\* Profit or loss

Trader observations include:

\\\* Entry thesis

\\\* Confidence

\\\* Emotion

\\\* Post-trade reflection

Each reviewed trade becomes a structured Decision Record.

Over time, those records form Trader Memory—a growing evidence base of repeated reasoning, behaviours, strengths, and mistakes.

The goal is not to judge one isolated trade.

It is to understand how the trader behaves across many trades.

From there, Aureon looks for recurring patterns and connects them to measurable outcomes.

But it has an important rule:

It does not declare a trading edge from one impressive result.

When the evidence is too small, it returns:

Insufficient evidence.

That may sound simple, but it was one of the most important design decisions in the project.

AI systems should not sound confident when the underlying evidence is weak.

For Aureon, honest uncertainty is more valuable than fabricated insight.

Version 1.0.0 includes:

\\\* MT5 and Exness trade import

\\\* Performance and behavioural analytics

\\\* Guided trade reviews

\\\* Decision Records

\\\* Trader Memory

\\\* Pattern Discovery

\\\* Edge Discovery

\\\* Evidence-based AI coaching

\\\* FastAPI and MCP integration

Today, I officially released Aureon AI Trading Coach v1.0.0 as an open-source project.

It is the first product within the wider Aureon Capital AI ecosystem.

The long-term goal is to build intelligent systems that improve decision-making in financial markets.

The idea behind the project can be summarized in two lines:

Most trading journals record trades.

Aureon records decisions.

I would genuinely appreciate feedback from traders, developers, and anyone working at the intersection of AI and financial markets.
